test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’ and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is D related to B if A ÷ B − C + D × E?

Given: A ÷ B − C + D × E

A ÷ B → A is the father of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4cefd4622d49fa73e7e1020b052b12b0fc58d3d0eda1ef2893980e09e9a6d3.png] 

B − C → B is the husband of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2089c50a9fa6e866c567a11f62f4f51d033c64b54f58d0fea91561679c9fd8a5.png] 

C + D → C is the daughter of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff62454be61d3e9da63ab8cb619c8cc6c0963bd7caee6a7183820baeb238b5f4.png] 

D × E → D is the mother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2909a8b76252c512b28c321d607ecda19a2c32fd778a4c841054a33a2312a9d0.png] 

Thus, D is the mother-in-law or wife's mother of B.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
